Necessary documents relating to such manpower will be uploaded by the bidder for verification of the buyer. Such manpower will be part of total manpower to be provided by the Service Provider in case he gets the contract against this bid. 11. The Contract of hiring of Vehicle will be for a period of one year (12 months) starting from the date of awarding of contract. It may be renewed / extended or terminated upon suitable notice. 2. GST Registration, if applicable, Registration with Transport Authority, RC Book, Pollution Certificate (and renewal of the same time to time), Insura nce of the vehicle to be deployed. The vehicle must be registered in the nam e of the firm/proprietor. The tenderer should be a well-established travel/tour agency / firm (hereinafter as the agency /firm / contractor). 3. The bidder should preferably have past experience of providing vehi cles on hire to at least one Government organization/PSU entity and submit t he proof. 4. The bidder should have the registered office in Hubli/Dharwad/place of providing the service and should provide the proof of the same. 5. Agreed rate as per agreement will not be revised during the agreement period.

6. The agency / firm would ensure that the driver employed have valid driving license and clean driving record including track record of not indulgin g in any major/minor accidents in the past three years. The vehicle or driver should not have indulged in any serious accident in the past three years. The driver of the vehicle must follow traffic rules and all other regulations prescri bed by the Government from time to time. The papers related to the vehicles including proper Registration certificate, insurance papers, pollution certifica te and all India permit certificate of the vehicle should be available / kept in t he vehicle at all times. 7. Contractor shall be solely responsible for any/all disputes between hi m and the personnel deployed by him. The office will not entertain any such dispute and there should be no claim or liability against CGST Dharwad Divis ion or any of its officers on this account. The Contractor will keep the CGST Dharwad Division and its officers indemnif ied against all actions. 8. The Contractor should specifically note that the engagement of the s ervice provider under this contract does not in any way confer any right on t he Service provider or the persons that may be deployed by him, for claimin g any regular employment in this office or any other Government Office. 9. The vehicles should not have LPG kits as fuel. 10. Manufacture year of the vehicles should be 2023 and onwards. 11. Vehicles should be kept with sufficient stock of fuel at all times. How ever, in case of any emergency, if any officer refuels on payment from his po cket, the same should be reimbursed by the contractor on production of the bill. 12. The agency/firm should have sufficient number of vehicle and drivers with them. In case of breakdown of vehicle or non-availability of vehicle or dri ver at any time, the firm shall provide substitute vehicle / driver immediately as the case may be. The drivers employed along with the vehicle should satis fy the following conditions: (i) The driver shall not hand over the vehicle to anyone under any circum stances. In the event the vehicle is given to another person for driving, the contractor/service provider will be held responsible for any acciden ts or incidents that occur. (ii) Drivers should have minimum 5 years of experience of driving. (iii) They should have valid vehicle transport licenses for driving passenger v ehicles.

(iv) Drivers should be well versed with the roads and the places and shoul d have experience in city as well as highway driving. (v) Once the driver has been allotted to the vehicle, he should remain wit h the same vehicle for the contract period. Any change in the designat ed driver should be on pre-intimation basis at least 48 hours before suc h change is affected. (vi) Driver should be provided with a mobile phone in operation at all times. (vii) An alternate contact number for contact should also be provided in ca se the original number is not reachable. (viii) Driver should be decent and well behaved and should not have any cri minal cases against him and should not have any past history of accide nts/alcoholism. Police verification for deployed staff shall be ensured b y the service provider. (ix) Staff Car should be kept clean and odour free and suitable for official use . (x) Driver should wear the formal driver dress. Drivers should not consu me gutka / pan masala or smoke in the car while driving. (xi) The driver shall not report for duty in an inebriated state. In such an e vent the department shall have full rights to terminate the contract wit h immediate effect. (xii) Any complaint from the users / staff of the CGST Dharwad Division with respect to the behaviour, will be viewed seriously and it will be br ought to the notice of the service provider, who shall take suitable actio n and report compliance to the user department within 24 hours from t he date of such complaint. (xiii) Gossiping with the guests and use of mobile phone while driving is not allowed. In case of an emergency, driver should park the vehicle at a c onvenient parking area with permission of the user and the talk in the mobile to the minimum duration. (xiv) Driver should attend any duties assigned to him from time to time. Dri vers should not use the vehicle for their personal use while on duty. 13. The vehicle should be in good running condition. In case, the condition of the vehicle is not found to be satisfactory, they shall be returned for immediate replacement. In case, no replacement is provided on time, a p enalty of Rs.500/- will be levied on day to day basis. In case the regular vehic le/driver do not report to duty on time, the vendor shall provide an alternate vehicle/driver. In case of failure to do so,

this office has right to hire a vehicle from the market and the cost incurred has to be borne by the age ncy/firm/the service provider. Further, the amount so incurred shall be recovered from the monthly fee /charge payable to the service provider. 14. Service provider should ensure that vehicle deployed arrives at desig nated location on time and with full tank fuel. In the event of any break-down , servicing and repairs of vehicles, non-arrival of vehicle without prior intimati on/without providing alternate vehicle, the service provider at his own cost s hall make alternative arrangement by providing similar or higher class of veh icle(s) for which agreement entered into. Failure to do so will evoke penalty e quivalent to amount of Rs.500/- for each day of absence or possible terminati on of contract. 15. A daily record indicating time and mileage for each vehicle shall be maintained by the driver in a log book in the prescribed format as per Gover nment’s instructions and this log book shall be submitted to the concerned of ficer in office on daily basis. 16. The contractor (agency/firm) shall not engage any sub-contractor or t ransfer the contract to any other person. The vehicles must be fitted with Fir e extinguisher in proper working condition at all times and the driver should be trained to use them. Periodical maintenance of the equipment should be e nsured by the service provider. 17. There should be at least two sets of white seat covers, towels and na pkins in each car. It should be washed and changed every week. There shoul d be an air spray in every car. The items mentioned shall be made available at the cost of the owner of the agency/firm. 18. It should be ensured that all electrical connections including lights (b oth front and back), horn, turn indicators, wipers, mobile charging and other vehicle systems shall be periodically checked and maintained by service pro vider to avoid any inconvenience to the user. 19. Vehicle should always be parked only at the place as advised by the offi cer in- charge. If the vehicle needs to be away for some reasons like re-fuelling, petty repairing etc., it should be with the knowledge of the controlling officer. Moving away without the knowledge of the controlling officer will be considered as non-available and will be liable for penalty. 21. A penalty of Rs.500/- per day per vehicle may be levied in case of un approved change of vehicle /driver, non-satisfactory performance or lack of p roper upkeep of the vehicle or non-observance or violation of any term or con dition prescribed above. The number of days will be calculated on the basis o f period during which the default continues or on the occasions of occurrence of the concerned events as applicable. However, in case of frequent violation

s of the terms or conditions, the contract can be cancelled forthwith without any notice. 22. The vehicle should be registered with the concerned transport autho rity of State Government. Self-attested photocopies of Registration Certificat e should be attached with the Technical Bid. The in-charge of the agency/fir m should be available for contact round the clock. Vehicles should have pollu tion clearance certificate issued by the competent authority. 23. Vehicles to be provided by the contractor have the comprehensive in surance to cover all risk as per the Motor Vehicle Act and relevant rules and regulations of the State Government and Central Government. 24. The service provider should ensure to provide an alternate driver for services on Sundays and closed holidays or any other day in lieu of a holiday to be given to the regular driver. Further, the holiday/Sunday driver in case o f weekly off for the regular driver shall be earmarked & intimated to the offic e. 25. Failure to provide alternate or non-provision of vehicle on Sunday/Clo sed holiday in lieu of regular driver will attract penalty of Rs.2000/-. 26. The rates quoted should be inclusive of the GST component. All other taxes, toll fee, levy, insurance charges, Fuel, Repairs & Maintenance, Driver c harges (including food and stay if required), and any other incidental charges etc., would be borne by the Agency/Firm. 27. The contractor shall be solely responsible for timely payment of wag es / salaries, other benefits, allowances to Drivers deployed and all other sta tutory / other dues payable as per Central / State Government / Municipality Rates / other Laws etc., as applicable to the personnel deployed that might b ecome applicable under any Act or Order of the Government. CGST Dharwad Division and its employees/officers shall have no liability whatsoever in this r egard. 28. The contractor will comply with all the Legal Rules, Regulations and Statutory obligations cast on him as per the Central / State Government / Mu nicipality / Local Bodies relating to such deployment of personnel. 29. The liability to pay all taxes / duties / other levies of Local Bodies, St ate & Central Government or any other Authority in respect of services rende red will vest with the contractor. 30. Non-receipt of payment from CGST Dharwad Division shall not be a r eason for his defaults in payment of salary to the drivers & other statutory pa yments or his liabilities, if any, during the contract period. The Service Provid er shall continue to provide the agreed services to the office.

31. The contractor should be financially sound enough to ensure timely payment of charges for his drivers, fleet operations, even in case of delayed payment from the department on administrative reasons and should convey his acceptance. 32. The contractor shall make regular, timely and full payment of labour charges, salaries and other payments as due, as per the labour laws or any o ther laws to its personnel deputed under the Service contract. 33. The CGST Dharwad Division shall be at liberty to withhold any amou nt in full or in part for default in service and / or for the loss incurred by the v ehicle shall have to be paid by the service provider. The decision of the CGST Dharwad Division will b e final and binding on the contractor and shall not be subject to any dispute or arbitration and the pen alties imposed will be recovered from the amount / payment due to the service provider. 34. All disputes will be subject to local jurisdiction only. 35. Rates once finalized will be fixed for the contract period or such exte nded period. Upward change in rates will not be considered due to any hike i n Petrol / Diesel, taxes or any other reason during the period of contract. 36. Tax Deduction at Source (TDS) at applicable rates as prescribed b y Income Tax Department, GST Act will be deducted at the time of paymen t, if applicable. 37. Proof of payment of appropriate GST and other statutory requiremen ts, if required, will be required to be submitted to this office regularly. 38. The vehicle should have necessary permits from the transport depart ment/authority. This office will not be responsible for any traffic rules violatio n / Contravention of Motor Vehicle Act challans, loss, damage and accident to the vehicle or any other vehicle or injury to anybody. In case of any accident, all the claims arising out of it shall be met by the agency/firm/service provide r. 39. It is obligatory for the agency/firm that drivers are paid not less than minimum wages prescribed under Minimum Wages Act fixed by the Govern ment from time to time and preferably within first week of the month without waiting for the payments of the bill by the office. 40. If any of the terms and conditions above, is not found fulfilled during the contract period, the CGST Dharwad Division reserves the right to termin ate the contract without assigning any reasons thereof. However, in normal c ourse this contract can be terminated with a notice period of one month by t he either side. 41. In case of any dispute, the decision of the CGST Dharwad Division sh all be final and binding. Any matter not specifically covered by this agreeme nt shall be decided by the CGST Dharwad Division.

42. The CGST Dharwad Division reserves the right to postpone and/or ex tend the date of receipt/opening of rates/quotation or reject or to withdraw th e same, without assigning any reason thereof. 43. Vehicle should be available 24/7 and driver should be available all time whenever called for and if regular driver not available , owner should arrang e alternative in advance with intimation to this office. Replacement should b e available for vehicle when actual vehicle is under maintenance. 44. Toll, Driver food, car freshener, tissue paper, napkin, neck rest and a ny other requirements or charges should be supplied by contractor/vehicle o wner only. Driver should be in proper uniform. Any police charges should be paid by contractor/owner only. Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they d on't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.
